mapper.select: SELECT R.RPT_ID, R.BRD_NO, B.BRD_TITL_NM, B.BRD_CONT, B.MBR_CD, B.BRD_PBLS_DTM, R.RPT_TARGET_ID, R.RPT_STATUS_CODE, R.RPT_CODE, M.MBR_STATUS_CODE AS RPT_TARGET_MBR_STATUS, M.MBR_ID AS RPT_TARGET_MBR_CD, L.LSTG_DEL AS LSTG_DEL FROM REPORT R JOIN BOARD B ON R.BRD_NO = B.BRD_NO LEFT JOIN MEMBER M ON R.RPT_CODE = 'MEMB' AND R.RPT_TARGET_ID = M.MBR_ID LEFT JOIN LISTING L ON R.RPT_CODE = 'LSTG' AND R.RPT_TARGET_ID = L.LSTG_ID WHERE R.RPT_ID = #{reportId}
mapper.update: UPDATE LISTING SET LSTG_DEL = #{lstgDel} WHERE LSTG_ID = #{lstgId}
